verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents more than one API version: there is a /api-documentation/v2 path, and the docs state that new API keys work with all versions. That covers the versioning half of the story. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a changelog. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, version sunset/migration timelines, a changelog or versioning guarantees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: New API keys are compatible with all versions of the API.
